# Kent - council briefing

*Auto-generated from council minutes, 28 April 2026 to 20 August 2026*

## What's dominating the agenda

Children & Education leads with 5,630 keyword hits, concentrated almost entirely in the Children, Young People and Education Cabinet Committee. Finance & Budget (2,720 hits, split across Cabinet, Policy and Resources Cabinet Committee and Scrutiny Committee) and Community Safety (2,562 hits, mainly the Crime and Disorder Committee/Scrutiny Committee) round out the top three.

## Notable decisions

- The Leader approved extending the Domestic Abuse Act Framework to March 2029 and the associated support contracts, worth around 6.5 million pounds, to maintain service continuity through recommissioning (key decision, 12 Aug).
- The Cabinet Member for Integrated Children's Services approved moving the Families First Partnership Programme into full delivery, implementing national children's social care reforms (key decision, 7 Aug).
- 7.2 million pounds was allocated to permanently expand Oakwood Park Grammar School by one form of entry, adding 30 places from September 2027 (key decision, 5 Aug).
- A 20 million pound Department for Transport grant was accepted for the Dover Border Access Improvement Project (key decision, 13 Jul).
- Cabinet noted the 2025-26 revenue and capital outturn position and agreed fund roll-forwards into 2026-27 (key decision, 25 Jun).
- Cabinet adopted the "Delivery of Local Government Efficiency" strategy, aimed at promoting cost-consciousness across the organisation (key decision, 22 Jul).

## Worth a closer look

- The Children, Young People and Education directorate scorecard tracks performance metrics across the service, produced monthly for the Cabinet Committee (14 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1511512/file)
- An update to the Kent Community Safety Partnership on progress developing the county's new Community Safety Agreement (23 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1523758/file)
- The Kent Health and Wellbeing Board met to coordinate health and care priorities across the county (23 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1523868/file)
- An equality impact assessment for the Kent Minerals Sites Plan, part of the ongoing review of mineral extraction sites in the county (16 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1511743/file)

## Projects on residents' radar

- **A226 Galley Hill scheme** - the council agreed to progress detailed design and public engagement for repairing this stretch of road near Northfleet, which collapsed in 2023 (22 May). [source](https://democracy.kent.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3093)
- **Sturry Link Road** - the Cabinet Member for Highways and Transport approved progressing construction of the A28 roundabout and associated works, using secured Section 106 funding (5 Feb). [source](https://democracy.kent.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3064)
- **Road of Remembrance embankment stabilisation, Dover** - the council approved moving this scheme to delivery, funding engineering works to stabilise the cliff after a major landslip closed the historic road in January 2024 (1 Apr). [source](https://democracy.kent.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3079)
- **Folkestone Library** - a key decision confirmed the long-term location of Folkestone's library and registration service and settled the future of the 2 Grace Hill building (6 Feb). [source](https://democracy.kent.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3065)
- **Kent Travel Saver bus pass scheme** - the council approved raising the price of this subsidised bus pass for 11 to 16 year-olds by £35 a year, to keep the scheme financially sustainable (27 May). [source](https://democracy.kent.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3096)
